basic_info.description: Grand scale, sophisticated, and rarely available condominium in the heart of the Marina. Steps from the Marina Green, stands the timeless and enchanting courtyard and Mediterranean-style facade of 3835 Scott St. The condo offers a generous floor plan with a large bedroom, a light filled living room with classic crown molding, multiple walk-in closets, a bathroom with a separate shower and soaking tub, and a fabulous renovated kitchen with top of the line stainless appliances.The ideal location, close to the Marina Green, Crissy Field and the fabulous restaurants and shopping on Chestnut St, coupled with one car deeded parking, low HOA dues, well-funded reserves, and a professionally managed building rounds out this unique opportunity.
